scope: Bilingual TV trivia page redesign; existing URLs and all 250 question identifiers retained

content.classification: Season 0 covers premise, cast and production facts. Positive seasons require completion of that season. The whole bilingual prompt, answer, choices and explanation are sealed together by contentKey. Any edit invalidates eligibility until rescreened and resealed.
content.formalReview: Existing review.status records remain pending. This implementation screening does not certify the separate editorial/provenance programme.

implemented: Ten visible shows with original illustrations, two-column phone and four-column wide layouts
Ten questions per round, four choices, manual Next, one point per correct answer
Untimed default; optional 20-second absolute deadline that does not reset on refresh
Spoiler limits shared by quiz, saved-round validation, and flashcards
Results, missed-answer review, replay, local bests, resumable rounds
Language switching preserves show, season, question, choices, answers and score
User-initiated text sharing and a 1080px score image preview/download link
Practice search, difficulty, progress, favourites, sorting and pagination
Existing account progress/favourite syncing and Battle Room entry points retained
Consent-gated view, start, answer, exit, complete, replay, share and score_card analytics

rates: sessions with a start / sessions with a TV-page view
sessions with a replay / sessions with a completed round
analytics.baseline: Historical analytics were not available in this task. Compare equivalent periods and consent-eligible sessions by language/device after release; no improvement percentages are claimed.

browser: bidirectional language switch with score and season preservation
320px and 390px phone widths without horizontal overflow
limits: Native file-download completion could not be confirmed in the in-app browser, although both score images rendered at 1080 by 1080 and expose download links
Local preview has no account or multiplayer backend; authenticated sync and rooms need a staging smoke test
Five-person first-use timing study is pending
Formal content sign-off and full accessibility certification are not claimed

maintenance: Author both languages and three aligned distractors; assign a conservative whole-card season limit.
After checking every visible field, set tvQuiz.contentKey = contentKey(card) from tv-trivia-engine.js. Never reseal unreviewed changes automatically.
Document source-content changes in the amendment ledger, preserving earlier repair hashes and existing IDs.
Regenerate catalog, search indexes, learning audit ledger, SEO pages and Arabic shared routes when their inputs change.
Run npm run test:tv, npm run test:contracts and npm --prefix site-worker test. The source build includes tracked files, so stage new runtime/assets before building.
